records.text: Fenwick Bakeries v. Corlett Freight Lines: complaint filed 2026-02-10 for 640,000 dollars of spoiled inventory after a refrigerated trailer failed on 2026-01-28.
Privileged client instruction, Fenwick Bakeries: CFO Ilse Dorrance authorized settlement at any figure above 350,000 dollars.
Fenwick mediation session 1 on 2026-08-04: Corlett opened at 90,000 dollars and did not move; session ended without a counter.
Fenwick mediation session 2 on 2026-09-15: after our expert damages model was served, Corlett moved to 380,000 dollars.
Fenwick v. Corlett settled on 2026-09-22 for 412,000 dollars. The amount is confidential under clause 9 of the settlement agreement.
Work product, Fenwick: our trailer temperature logs have a six-hour gap on 2026-01-28, the night of the failure.
Pell Harbor Marine v. Ardent Cold Storage: complaint filed 2026-04-02 for 1.2 million dollars of water damage to 14 stored marine engines.
Pell Harbor mediation is set for 2026-11-05 before mediator Ruth Okafor; mediation statements are due 2026-10-29.
Privileged client instruction, Pell Harbor Marine: do not settle below 780,000 dollars without the owner on the call.
Pell Harbor strategy: our expert damages report is due 2026-10-28; serve it before the mediation statement, not at the session.
Pell Harbor discovery: Ardent produced the sprinkler maintenance logs only after our motion to compel was granted on 2026-08-19.

Handoff note from Mira Castell: Jonah Reyes takes over Pell Harbor on 2026-10-16. Read Garrick Holm's profile before the 2026-11-05 mediation; he was opposing counsel in another of our matters this year.
Garrick Holm opens a mediation far below what he expects to pay and does not move in the first session.
Garrick Holm moves only after he has a written expert damages model in hand; serve it before the session, not at it.
Garrick Holm never agrees to a deadline extension without asking for one of equal length back.
Garrick Holm needs about 48 hours to get settlement authority from his client's insurer; plan a follow-up day after any mediation.
Garrick Holm withheld Ardent's sprinkler maintenance logs until a motion to compel was granted; expect the same on any further request.
Garrick Holm settled Fenwick v. Corlett at 412,000 dollars, 64 percent of our 640,000 dollar demand, after the second mediation session.
Garrick Holm's final offer cleared Fenwick's authority of 350,000 dollars by 62,000 dollars; he never learned our floor.
Garrick Holm knows about the six-hour gap in Fenwick's temperature logs and used it at the second mediation.
